reason: Rails' `"w:utf-8"` carries Ruby's external-encoding suffix (database_tasks.rb:441); ruby-compat's File.open passes the mode straight to FsAdapter.openSync, which takes plain flags, so the port passes `"w"`.

Rails runs SchemaDumper.dump INSIDE the File.open block (database_tasks.rb:441-443); trails' SchemaDumper.dump is async and File.open's block is synchronous, so the dump has to complete before the file is opened.
